findings.location: Definition, first paragraph, pre-reader line 33: claimed equivalence between local W^{1,2} membership and ACL representatives.
findings.evidence: The observed equivalence omitted square-integrability of coordinate derivatives. On (-1,1)^2, f(x+iy)=sgn(x)|x|^{1/4}+iy is an ACL homeomorphism, but its squared x derivative is (1/16)|x|^{-3/2}, which is not locally integrable near x=0. The opened ACL characterization requires L^2 coordinate derivatives. The producer corrected the current clause during review. This historical finding binds independently read and raw-hashed original bytes to the matching immutable pre-reader hash.

findings.location: Statement (b): claimed equivalence of the weak Cauchy–Riemann equation and zero Beltrami coefficient under only Sobolev regularity.
findings.evidence: For f(z)=conjugate(z), a Sobolev homeomorphism of C, f_z=0 and f_zbar=1. The opened coefficient definition assigns mu_f=0 wherever f_z=0, refuting the claimed equivalence. It requires the additional condition f_zbar=0 on {f_z=0}, or restriction to analytic quasiconformal maps. The producer added the missing condition during review. This historical finding binds independently read and raw-hashed original bytes to the matching immutable pre-reader hash.
